build_scope: UI source commit with frozen bootstrap/build tools from d23f232; current-main network policy excluded from this binary and acceptance.
contracts: The shared plain View row host is now RustRowView. It serves sidebar rows, palette suggestions, two-line history results and the sidebar address pill. These production paths no longer construct Button/ButtonController instances; native comparison retains RowButton and existing Label policy. Other control families and native fallback preference rows remain separately inventoried.

Palette chip and address geometry/metrics/fallback fonts reuse existing Rust row/address recipes and native font/vector adapters. History reuses the exact shared-canvas kind25 recipe and has no Label or FocusRing children, retaining its previous shared-paint policy. The SceneHistoryRow and UrlPill subclasses are removed.

The native tooltip-to-AX-name policy is explicitly preserved: updating a tooltip changes an empty name or a name equal to the previous tooltip, while custom names remain. History retains URL names and date/URL descriptions, palette chips retain detail descriptions, and address updates retain their named AX adapter and host/path description.

One pending-input watch registry serves sidebar, palette and tools. Each viewport callback synchronously checks only pending row/close input before GPU coalescing, allows reentrant cancellation and removes destroyed watches. It replaces the history whole-tree scroll scan. The Rust input model is unchanged; no per-move repaint is scheduled when its visual is unchanged.

New shared tests verify actual host types, AX metadata and offscreen AX dispatch to the intended URL. Rust-specific branches check palette/history row and widget clip cancellation, immediate scroll out/back and replacement at a reused result index. Existing real Cocoa history Space, palette keyboard/IME/selection/mouse, shared history canvas/fallback and sidebar regressions retain their original outcomes through View adapters.

Existing browser/profile/query/URL/store/admission/persistence commands remain native. Row spec/domain data, native node identity and preferred-size constants remain open ownership work. No dependency or native browser policy change.
limits: Full automated acceptance does not prove complete functional/manual/release parity.
Other control/container/menu/window/input ownership, stable Rust node identity and remaining UI coordination/placement remain open.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.
gpu_log_diagnostics_note: Nonfatal compositor diagnostics remain unresolved. Counts do not establish performance gains.
